The first WCA competition in Barbados! 🇧🇧 

This competition serves as the 2025 national championship for Barbados. We welcome participants of all ages and skill levels. Competitors of all nationalities are welcome to participate, but only those with Barbadian citizenship are eligible for the national championship titles.
